function InsideBlock<Z>() {
  type Key<O, LocalZ, P extends (LocalZ extends true ? keyof O : keyof O)> = P;
  type Success<T, K extends keyof T> = T[K] extends {key: 'x'} ? Key<T[K], Z, 'key'> : never;
  const result: Success<{one: {key: 'x'}}, 'one'> = 'key';
  return result;
}
type Key<O, Z, P extends (Z extends true ? keyof O : keyof O)> = P;
type Outside<T, K extends keyof T, Z> = T[K] extends {key: 'x'} ? Key<T[K], Z, 'key'> : never;
const result: Outside<{one: {key: 'x'}}, 'one', boolean> = 'key';
console.log(InsideBlock<true>(), result);
